attackers_goals: Gain persistence using the legitimate Windows registry run key mechanism, which executes files or scripts on user login or computer boot.
description: An attacker may add a file to the Registry "Run Keys" or the "Winlogon\Userinit" key to cause it to be executed as the user logs in.
investigative_actions: Verify if the registered file is malicious. Check if the installing software is a malicious binary or script.
name: An uncommon file added to startup-related Registry keys
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
